name: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
summary: Open protocol that standardizes how AI applications connect to external tools, data sources and prompts via MCP servers.
description: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard, introduced by Anthropic in November 2024, for connecting LLM applications (hosts/clients) to external capabilities exposed by **MCP servers**: tools, resources and prompts. It uses JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio or Streamable HTTP transports, and has official SDKs in many languages.

agent_access.notes: Specification and docs are public; MCP servers define their own auth (OAuth 2.1 recommended for remote servers).
